resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Hindi source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Hindi pass identified 25 actionable protected-formula, variable-name, and technical-terminology defects across Ohm, Joule, Kirchhoff, TCR, trigonometry, and thermal content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Hindi human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Ohm-law formula localized protected variable names into Hindi words.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘वी = आई × आर’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘V = I × R’.

findings.summary: The current definition repeated the Hindi word for ampere and used a localized variable inconsistently.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘एम्पीयर या एम्पीयर (ए)’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a concise definition of I in amperes (A).

findings.summary: The rearranged current formula localized the variable names.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘मैं = वी/आर’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘I = V / R’.

findings.summary: The rearranged resistance formula localized the variable names.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘आर = वी/आई’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘R = V / I’.

findings.summary: The current worked formula localized variables and units.
evidence: The previous expression used Hindi words for I, V, and A.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected SI expression for current.

findings.summary: The resistance worked formula localized variables and units.
evidence: The previous expression used Hindi words for R, V, and A.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected SI expression for resistance.

findings.summary: The voltage worked formula localized variables and units.
evidence: The previous expression used Hindi words for V, A, and volts.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected SI expression for voltage.

findings.summary: The electrical-power formula localized all protected variable names.
evidence: The previous expression used पी, वी, आई, and आर.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘P = V × I = I^2 × R = V^2 / R’.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating description retained an English loan phrase.
evidence: The previous description used ‘जूल हीटिंग’ in otherwise Hindi content.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with the Hindi term जूल तापन.

findings.summary: All three Joule-heating formulas localized protected variable names.
evidence: The previous expressions used Hindi words for P, V, I, and R.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected P = V × I, P = I^2 × R, and P = V^2 / R expressions.

findings.summary: The practical-checks title used an informal literal translation.
evidence: The previous title was ‘व्यावहारिक जांच’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘व्यावहारिक परीक्षण’.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff current-law formulas localized protected current symbols.
evidence: The previous expressions used Hindi words for I, I_in, and I_out.
findings.resolution: Restored Σ I = 0 and Σ I_in = Σ I_out.

findings.summary: The series-resistance formula localized R_total.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘R_कुल’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘R_total = R_1 + R_2 + ...’.

findings.summary: The series-resistance example formula localized R_total.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘R_कुल’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘R_total = 0.40 Ω’.

findings.summary: The TCR coefficient formula contained corrupted degree-unit characters.
evidence: The previous expression rendered the degree unit as a control character.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected α and °C notation.

findings.summary: The TCR temperature-change formula contained corrupted degree-unit characters.
evidence: The previous expression rendered 80 °C with a control character.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘ΔT = 100 - 20 = 80 °C’.

findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas localized protected geometry labels and variables.
evidence: The previous expressions used Hindi words inside sin, cos, and tan formulas.
findings.resolution: Restored the standard sin, cos, and tan expressions with opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The basic heat-capacity formulas localized protected variable names.
evidence: The previous expressions used Devanagari variable names for C, Q, m, and c.
findings.resolution: Restored C = Q / ΔT and Q = m × c × ΔT.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating formula localized Q and P.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘क्यू = पी × टी’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘Q = P × t’.

findings.summary: The latent-heat formula localized Q, m, and L.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘क्यू = एम × एल’.
findings.resolution: Restored ‘Q = m × L’.

findings.summary: The Joule worked-example title used an ungrammatical literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was ‘काम किया उदाहरण’.
findings.resolution: Standardized the surrounding section terminology in the correction overlay.

findings.summary: The electrical-power paragraph mixed localized units with a literal safety phrase.
evidence: The previous paragraph used वी, डब्ल्यू, and a literal ‘हेडरूम’ phrase.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with protected SI notation and a clear safety-margin phrase.

findings.summary: The current-law title used the generic word for current instead of the electrical term धारा.
evidence: The previous title was ‘किरचॉफ का वर्तमान कानून’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘किरचॉफ का धारा नियम’.

findings.summary: The TCR result formula used localized punctuation and variables inconsistently with the preceding formulas.
evidence: The result was not aligned with the restored α and ΔT expressions.
findings.resolution: The corrected overlay preserves the protected R_T result notation.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating section title used an awkward literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was ‘विद्युत शक्ति से गर्म करना’.
